parole.testo: From earlier półk, połk, ultimately from Proto-Slavic *pъlkъ. The phonetic change of oł > ół > uł suggests a borrowing from Old Ruthenian полкъ (polk), although the evolution l̥ > oł > uł or l̥ > oł or uł after a labial consonant is probably also possible in Polish. Displaced native Old Polish *pełk
